entries.title: Spaceflight Sim
entries.author: KampfGuy (original by Rough_Capital1339 / CatPrinceHQ2)
entries.description: Build rockets in the hangar, launch, reach orbit and land. The whole sim is written in KampfScript.

entries.title: Sky Hopper 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: 3D platformer: hop the Kugel across floating islands and moving platforms to the golden ring. Checkpoints, gems, best time. Needs Kompass 1.5.2+.

entries.title: Asteroid Run 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: 3D space shooter: fly through an asteroid field, blast rocks before your guns overheat, grab shield rings. Faster waves, high score. Needs Kompass 1.5.2+.

entries.title: Kugel Bowling 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: 3D bowling: aim, charge your throw and knock down all 10 pins. 5 frames, strike and spare bonuses, best game saved. Needs Kompass 1.5.2+.

entries.title: Bouncy Ball
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Click to throw a glowing ball around. A tiny canvas + on_frame demo.

entries.title: Kugel Clicker
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Click the Kugel, buy upgrades. Your coins are saved.

entries.title: Kugel Snake
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Classic snake with glowing orbs, wrap-around walls and speed-up. Arrows / WASD, Space pause.

entries.title: Flappy Kugel
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Flap through the pipes! Space, ↑ or click. How far can you get?

entries.title: Kugel Breakout
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Smash every brick with paddle and ball. Mouse or ← →, Space to launch. Levels get tougher.

entries.title: Kugel Asteroids
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Rotate, thrust and blast rocks that split apart. Waves keep coming.

entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Slide the tiles, merge equal numbers, reach 2048. Arrows / WASD.

entries.title: Pong vs AI
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: You vs the computer, first to 7. W/S, arrows or mouse.

entries.title: Arena Shooter
entries.author: Grok
entries.description: Top-down survival: WASD / arrows move, mouse aim, click or Space to shoot, R restart.

entries.title: Star Dodger
entries.author: Claude
entries.description: Arrows / WASD move, Space shoots. Survive, smash rocks, beat your best.

entries.title: NEON DODGE
entries.author: ChatGPT
entries.description: A tiny arcade survival game: dodge the red drones. WASD / arrows, R to restart.

entries.title: Kugel 3D Modeler
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Blender-style 3D modeling that runs on weak PCs: shapes, edit vertices/faces, extrude, move/rotate/scale (G/R/S), materials, lights, render PNG, OBJ/glTF/GLB, send models to your 3D games. Needs Kompass 1.7.0+.

entries.title: Kugel Blocks
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Make games with drag-and-drop blocks, like Scratch: sprites, costumes + paint editor, sounds, clones, variables, your own blocks. See the KampfScript your blocks make, export a playable game. Needs Kompass 1.7.0+.

entries.title: Kugel Blocks 3D
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Make 3D games with blocks: actors, walk/jump/gravity, solid walls, follow and first-person cameras, sky/fog/light, models from the Kugel 3D Modeler, gamepads. Samples: Coin Run, Maze Walk, Space Dodge. Needs Kompass 1.7.0+.

entries.title: Kugel Mail
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Private email app for Windows (Gmail, Yahoo, any IMAP): folders, search, reply/forward, attachments, remote images blocked by default. A separate download (mail needs network access store pages don't have).

entries.title: Kugel Arithmetricks
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: A real calculator in the Windows 11 style: Standard, Scientific, Programmer (HEX/DEC/OCT/BIN), date calculation and 10 unit converters. History, memory, keyboard, light and dark theme. Needs Kompass 1.8.0+.

entries.title: Arithmetricks Premium
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Satirical pay-to-win calculator game: buy the digits, the equals sign is extra, CalcBank debt tiers, a $100/min Premium subscription, the Employee Portal and Chapter 7. Fake money only, fully offline. Needs Kompass 1.8.0+.

entries.title: Kugel Notes
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Notes with folders, Markdown formatting, checklists, pins and search. Import and export .md / .txt. Everything stays on this PC. Needs Kompass 1.8.0+.

entries.title: Kugel Lattice
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Spreadsheets: formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, IF, VLOOKUP and more), several sheets, formatting, charts, CSV and .xlsx import / export. Needs Kompass 1.8.0+.

entries.title: Kugel Paint
entries.author: KampfGuy
entries.description: Painting like a small Photoshop / Fresco: layers with opacity and blend modes, brushes, eraser, fill, shapes, selection (copy / move / crop), filters, undo, PNG import / export. Needs Kompass 1.8.0+.
